definitions.send_clock: hrtime at entry to real SocketMutable::sendto
definitions.receiver_clock: hrtime after recvfrom in a separate OS process
definitions.wire_clock: tcpdump/libpcap kernel timestamps on Linux loopback, microsecond resolution
definitions.late_intervals_over_1ms: inter-packet send gap > ptime + 1 ms; inferred missed relative deadlines, not an internal pacer counter
definitions.missed_full_slots: max(0, floor((gap_ms - 1) / ptime_ms) - 1), summed over gaps; never a discarded media frame
definitions.cpu: sender process getrusage user+system / scenario wall time, percent of one core
definitions.memory: PHP peak / maximum RSS accumulated up to each scenario; includes harness and caches
definitions.integrity: packet count, SHA-256 at receiver, sequence and timestamp continuity; audio encoder sequence additionally checked by 08_audio_preparation.php
